name: Truebit
fix_description: In func_1446 (internal function called by getPurchasePrice), the addition of v9 + v12 can overflow uint256 without any check. Add SafeMath add() to the addition, or refactor the formula to divide by common factors before summing to keep intermediate results within 2^256.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit loop itself is mechanically simple (buy then immediately sell), but deriving the correct malicious amount requires understanding the protocol-specific bonding curve math and reverse-solving the pricing formula to trigger an extreme mispricing. An experienced auditor could build this in under a couple of hours after reading the pool logic, but it is not an obvious generic bug pattern.
